data.narrative:
Bedrock Robotics, a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Boris Sofman, Kevin Peterson, Ajay Gummalla, and Tom Eliaz, is valued at $1.75B post-money following $350M+ in total capital raised. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private robotics firms at Series B/C stages—including Generalist AI ($2.0B), Dexterity ($1.6B), Agile Robots ($1.0B), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B)—plus one public comparable.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier to the $1.8B last post-money valuation, implying $3.3B. Peer-median analysis across the four sampled same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.3B, with a range of $1.0B–$2.0B. The stage-progression method reflects forward-looking capital step-up dynamics; the peer-median method anchors to current observable market pricing for direct competitors.

These methods triangulate to a median valuation of $2.3B, with a defensible range of $1.1B to $3.8B. The current $1.75B valuation sits below the median but within the lower-to-mid range, consistent with recent-round post-money. Key uncertainties include the trajectory of future fundraising multiples and the extent to which Bedrock's operational metrics diverge from the peer cohort.
